_comment: One deployment per country: NEXT_PUBLIC_COUNTRY_CODE picks an entry (default vn), at build time.
Keys are the Quran API's countries.code; `localization` is that country's localizations.code
(the Quran apps' locale) and `language` the hadith language it maps to through
hadith_languages.localization_id. `ui` is the interface language wanted: it is used when
lib/locales has that catalog, otherwise the interface falls back to English. There is no
right-to-left interface yet: ar, ur and ku get the English interface (lib/i18n.js).
An entry with "international": true (ac) is one site for every language, with no
`localization`: the content and interface languages follow the reader (lib/language.js),
`language` and `ui` are only the defaults, and English is shown beside other languages.
`accent`: the colour stops of the band behind the home page's cards and of a wordmark's bar;
without one, the brand green (styles/_variables.scss). `shareImage`: og:image.
Check against a running API: npm run check:sites

kr.name: Korea
kr.note: No Korean hadith translation in the sources yet: content in English
